reason: A configuration utility that exposes reasoning-strength settings for hand-declared custom llm-pi-ai providers and persists selected model capabilities for use by the model picker and request path.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中手动声明的自定义 llm-pi-ai 提供商配置模型的思考强度、默认级别和思考格式。
summaries.en: Configures reasoning-effort levels, provider defaults, and thinking formats for hand-declared custom llm-pi-ai providers in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Adds a settings page for configuring reasoning-effort levels on custom llm-pi-ai provider models
Writes selected reasoningEfforts, provider defaults, and thinking formats to persisted llm-pi-ai settings
Auto-saves configuration changes after a 600 ms debounce
Applies reasoning levels from an embedded catalog of known models
